Input the tumor. Output the vaccine. Gamgee Technologies is building software that turns a dog’s tumor and healthy DNA into a personalized mRNA cancer vaccine design. Founder Paul Steven Conyngham spent 17 years in machine learning and had no biology background. When his dog Rosie was dying of cancer, he taught himself genomics, designed a vaccine around her tumor mutations, and coordinated the entire path from sequencing through manufacture and administration. Several of Rosie’s tumors shrank by 50-75%. Doing it by hand took a year and cost around $20,000. Gamgee’s target is a vaccine design in 48 hours at an end-to-end cost of $2,000. More than 300 dogs are already on the waitlist, and the company is preparing a clinician-led trial in 30 dogs to evaluate safety, immune response, and clinical outcomes. https://www.gamgee.io Congrats on the launch, Paul! 🚀 https://lnkd.in/gbmFc2Kj

Context.dev (YC S26) turns the live web into structured data for AI agents and applications via API. Agents can send URLs, domains, websites, sitemaps, companies, or files and get back clean Markdown, screenshots, company data, or structured JSON matching their schema. Instead of maintaining browsers, proxies, crawlers, parsers, queues, retries, and caches, developers can use one API to collect, structure, and continuously refresh internet data. Context.dev also supports large-scale workloads through Batches and ongoing updates through Monitors. The company is already used by more than 400 customers, including Mintlify, Passionfroot, Rho, Super, and SimilarWeb. Try it with 500 free credits at context.dev . Congrats on the launch, Yahia Bakour ! 🚀 https://lnkd.in/gS9A__f4

Masdar Americas is excited to welcome Daniel Hu as the 2026 Summer Intern! Daniel is a rising senior at Georgetown University, where he is pursuing a degree in International Economics and Computer Science. Throughout his internship, he will be supporting a variety of projects across the business, including automating monthly stakeholder reports and assisting with financial forecasting. Prior to joining Masdar Americas, Daniel interned with the U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC), where he contributed to sanctions-related research and economic analysis. This summer, Daniel is eager to expand his knowledge of the renewable energy sector, with a particular focus on the valuation and acquisition of renewable energy platforms and the operational requirements of renewable energy assets. We are pleased to have Daniel on our team and look forward to supporting his professional development. #MasdarAmericasInternshipProgram #FutureLeaders #RenewableEnergy #GeorgetownUniversity #ProfessionalDevelopment

Only 1% of podcasts ever started make it past episode 20, and Rerouted is now one of them! Making Rerouted has pushed me far outside of my comfort zone with what I share online and what I thought that I could be good at. It's also a shocking amount of work. I estimate that on average each episode takes about 10 hours to produce from guest acquisition to announcement. That doesn't include the time to think about where I want to go and if what I'm making is any good. I'm very proud of myself for doing something hard and sticking with it. I love getting to talk with some of the coolest, smartest, and most tenacious people I've ever met for an hour and sharing it. Thank you to everyone who has come on the show, engaged with my content, or reached out to give feedback. If you or someone you know has a non-linear or unique career path, let me know so we can get you on! Here's a picture of me recording my first ever episode in a Missouri Airbnb. #Rerouted #ReroutedPodcast
